about: Indian budgets. G02: state budget data normalised by Open Budgets India (CBGA's repo + the Wayback Machine's copy of its catalogue). G03: PFMS public reports (pfms.gov.in, through the hub's Indian proxies): scheme outlays per year and the implementing agency registry. G01: Union Budget and Economic Survey documents from the Wayback Machine's copy of www.indiabudget.gov.in (the live site refuses this scraper, so its own project is parked).
